review_copy.method: re-encode of ep009-full.mp4 video at libx264 crf 23, audio stream copied

method: ffmpeg 8.1.1 single filter graph (assembly/_tools/graph.txt): each segment trimmed by frame from its source (trim start_frame/end_frame, setpts, scale 1280x720, setsar=1, yuv420p), 75 segments concatenated, fps 24; program audio is the master WAV itself upmixed at unity (pan=stereo|c0=c0|c1=c0), apad to 59214000 samples (0.023 s digital silence after the master); libx264 crf 16 preset medium + aac 256k 48 kHz stereo, faststart. No per-segment audio, no re-renders, no paid calls, no source changes.
